illustrations.name: companions
illustrations.prompt: Create a production mobile-app illustration asset for Crittr from the attached design reference. Isolate ONLY the illustration described below, no phone frame, no UI, no lettering, no brand wordmark, no price, no card. Match the warm, charming hand-drawn illustration style: confident thin uneven black ink outlines, subtly textured soft flat watercolor color fills, warm golden dog, fluffy white cat, small peach accents. Crisp clean silhouette on a genuinely TRANSPARENT background, no cream/white rectangle, no background blobs (the app draws its own blobs), no drop shadow, no decorative large surrounding shapes. Artwork tightly fills the canvas but preserve every ear, paw and tail without clipping. Same character identity as the reference. Render the exact happy golden retriever and smaller white cat shoulder-to-shoulder from the top of this reference, waist-up/bust view, retriever taller on left and cat nestled on right, a tiny peach heart and 3 short black hand-drawn rays around them. Landscape canvas. Preserve the composition of this reference's hero artwork.
